title: Stack-A red node not independently classifiable as benign; candidate mechanism contradicted by static code
evidence: Candidate claims the single stack-A failure (test_dc12r1_contract_d_statement_print.py :: test_pending_1001_return_400_range_too_large, line 1909 'assert "1000" not in r.text') is caused solely by a random UUID containing '1000'. Static analysis contradicts this: (a) the STATEMENT_RANGE_TOO_LARGE mapper emits a FIXED string 'Statement range is too large. Choose a shorter date range.' (backend/api/v1/statement_http.py) with no UUID and no digit string '1000'; (b) the pending cap fires at len(pending_rows) > STATEMENT_LINE_CAP (backend/services/print_service.py:583, cap=1000) so a 1001-pending request returns 400 with that static body. Under correct behavior the assertion passes; if the cap failed to fire the FIRST failing assertion would be status_code==400, not the '1000' line. Kilo did not execute a deterministic PG16 replay and cannot claim one. Claims (2) and (3) of the mandated proof are therefore unproven and the stated root cause is unsupported.

title: Bind-time wholesaler re-resolution lacks active/non-deleted enforcement
evidence: core/join_intent.verify_join_intent only checks signature+expiry (no DB re-resolution). The caller retailer_provisioning_service._load_wholesaler (line 337) resolves the wholesaler ONLY by id-existence (None->404) and does NOT re-verify is_deleted (soft-delete on PublicBaseModel) or status (active/suspended/deactivated). The public lookup path (public_join.py) DID check is_deleted at issue time, but between lookup and registration a soft-deleted/deactivated supplier could still be bound. This deviates from the explicit requirement 'Validation must re-resolve a current, active, non-deleted wholesaler.'

title: 15 xfailed tests present in route-authorization policy suite
evidence: backend/tests/test_route_authorization_policy.py contains xfail markers (e.g. line 503 'marked xfail to document the findings WITHOUT relaxing the harness'). These are disclosed in the candidate's published backend counts (15 xfailed) and document a route-authorization finding rather than weaken the dual-entry assertions. No '.only'/skip/assertion-removal found in the four H2-A-R1 test modules. Verify none of the 15 xfails mask a dual-entry/self-join defect before any future PASS.

title: Residual bare /retail/login handoff link
evidence: RetailerJoinPage.tsx:337 contains a bare <Link to="/retail/login"> (sign-in helper). The canonical post-registration handoff uses /retail/login?w=<server-verified code> (RetailerJoinPage.tsx:497, InvitationLandingPage.tsx:367, RetailerSetupCredentialPage.tsx:95; AppRouter.tsx canonicalizes /retail/login). The bare link is a sign-in convenience, not a registration-result handoff, but the requirement 'No bare /retail/login ... handoff remains' should be confirmed.
